summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns Update on every path, building the prologue from the single declaration group on the empty path before the early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the new tests and the existing prepareQuery and DAWG update tests are unverified. Least certain: the initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE group yields one solution. No commit was made.
